0.original: To gauge your potential, Guildmaster Geva wants you to prepare a circle of leather.

1.original: Geva has instructed you to prepare a circle of leather. Craft the item as requested and present it to her.

2.original: Geva sees potential in you, despite your painfully amateurish technique. Potential is nothing without commitment, however. If you harbor hopes of producing work worthy of the Fen<hex:021F0103>Yll name, you must continue to apply yourself. Though the burden of expectation is heavy, you resolve to spare no effort in your attempt to master the craft of leatherworking.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※The next leatherworker quest will be available from Geva upon reaching level 5.

24.original: Deliver a circle of leather to Geva.

48.original: Well, you've passed the first test─gripping your knife by the handle and not the pointy end.

49.original: Now it's time to see how well you can wield it.

50.original: Make me a circle of leather. You'll need an animal skin to do so.

51.original: Newcomers to our craft often imagine that they need to hunt in order to obtain their materials. But if you have the sense the gods gave a chocobo's arse, you'd realize that's <hex:021A020203>hardly<hex:021A020103> the case.

52.original: Osgyth, over by our receptionist, sells most of the items commonly used in our craft. However, she cannot supply you with earth shards.

53.original: And that's it for my advice─the rest is up to you. Once you've made the circle of leather, bring it here to be inspected.

54.original: I can't say I have great expectations for your work. Just see to it you do not waste good skins. Now, away with you.

55.original: To synthesize a circle of leather for Guildmaster Geva, select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Logs<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> from the main menu, followed by <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Crafting Log<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

57.original: When you've finished, bring it here to be inspected. See Osgyth if you lack the necessary materials.

58.original: To synthesize a circle of leather for Guildmaster Geva, select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Logs<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> from the main menu, followed by <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Crafting Log<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

59.original: Aye, this is indeed leather...after a fashion.

60.original: Your work is amateurish in the extreme. The leather is unevenly tanned and practically unusable.

62.original: Well, about as much promise as the leather you haphazardly crafted.

63.original: Still, it is apparent that you paid due respect to the life from which it came.

64.original: Had you performed any worse, I'd have cast you out without a second thought. But you didn't, so I won't. Approach each task in earnest as you did today, and I'll continue to advise you.

65.original: However, you alone are responsible for your development. This is a business we're running, and neither I nor your seniors have the time to hold your hand.

66.original: Apply yourself to learning our techniques, and return here when you have acquired some skills. Mayhaps then I will have an errand for you to run.

67.original: The next leatherworker quest will be available from Geva upon reaching level 5.
